rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (Codex hit its limit, human reviewer just said 'lgtm'), so both candidates trivially satisfy recall by reaching the same approve conclusion. Candidate X earns its verdict with specific, diff-consistent reasoning (traces the rename to the upstream ServingTokenization refactor, checks all call sites, notes updated test coverage) — concrete and useful even though unblocking. Candidate Y is a bare 'terminal state: complete, 0 findings' with no evidence of what was checked or why it's safe, giving it essentially no actionability or demonstrated grounding despite reaching the correct outcome.
